romanized_text:
shahar ke bichon-bicha ek bahut purani pustakalay thi. log kahate the ki vahan ki kuch kitaben sau sal se bhi adhik purani hain. din men vahan chatron aur shodhakartaon ki bhida lagi rahati thi, lekin sham hote hi pura bhavan shant ho jata tha.

ek din arav nam k chatr itihas ki pariyojan ke lie samagri khojane vahan gaya. use ek dhul se dhaki hui alamari mili, jo samanyatah band rahati thi. alamari ke bhitar use chamadae ke kavar vali ek dayari dikhai di. dayari ke pahale panne para likha tha, jo bhi ise padhae, vaha saty ki khoj puri kare.

arav utsuk ho gaya. usane dayari padhana shuru kiya. usamen shahar ke ek bhule-bisare vyapari k ullekh tha, jisane varshon pahale kai garib parivaron ki madad ki thi, lekin usak nam itihas men kahin darj nahin tha. dayari men kuch sanket aur purane nakshe bhi bane hue the.

agale kai dinon tak arav un sanketon k pich karat rah. antatah use nagar abhilekhagar men aise dastaveja mile jinhonne vyapari ki kahani ko saty siddh kara diya. usaki khoj ke bad nagar parishad ne us vyakti ke samman men ek smarak sthapit kiya.

arav ne sikh ki itihas keval badai ghatanaon k nahin, balki un logon k bhi hota hai jinake achche kary samay ke sath bhul die jate hain.

key_events: A very old library exists in the middle of the city
People say that some books there are older than a hundred years
During the day, students and researchers visit the library
In the evening, the entire building becomes quiet
event_chain.scene_goal: Introduce the ancient library and its daily rhythm
event_chain.location: The old library in the middle of the city
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the first scene, the library now serves as a quiet place for learning

key_events: Arav goes to search for materials for the project
Arav finds a dusty chest that is usually locked
Inside the chest, Arav discovers a diary with a note about the pursuit of truth
event_chain.scene_goal: Advance the plot by having Arav uncover a potential source of knowledge
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the introduction of the ancient library, Arav now searches for materials

key_events: Arav starts reading the diary
He finds a mention of a forgotten merchant who helped poor families years ago but whose name is not recorded in history
The diary contains clues and old maps
event_chain.scene_goal: Arav uncovers a potential source of knowledge
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the previous event, Arav now reads the diary and discovers clues about a forgotten merchant

key_events: Arav continues searching for clues over several days
Arav discovers documents in the city archives that confirm the merchant’s story
Following the discovery, the city council establishes a monument in honor of the merchant
event_chain.scene_goal: Show that Arav’s research leads to public recognition of the merchant’s legacy
event_chain.narrative_link: Following Arav’s uncovering of a potential source of knowledge, Arav now finds documents proving the merchant’s story and leads to a monument being erected

key_events: Arav learns that history is not only about major events but also about people whose good deeds are forgotten over time
event_chain.scene_goal: Convey Arav’s expanded understanding of history beyond major events
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the public recognition of the merchant’s legacy, Arav now learns that history includes forgotten good deeds
